subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Gracious
solution: The correct answer is **"Rude."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Gracious"** means courteous, kind and pleasant, so the opposite would be something that is impolite or discourteous. ((व्‍यक्ति या उसका आचरण) दयालु, नम्र और उदार) • **Example**: *She has a **gracious**__ smile.* • **"Rude"** is the best antonym as it means impolite or lacking manners. (अशिष्‍ट (किसी के प्रति) (किसी बात पर)) __ • **Example**: *It’s **rude**__ to interrupt when people are speaking.* • *​*Hence*, *the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word is** "Rude."** • *​*So, the correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Active"** means engaged in physical or mental activity. (सक्रिय, क्रियाशील; चुस्‍त, फुरतीला, जीवंत) • **"Passive"** means accepting or allowing what happens without active response or resistance. (जो कोई प्रतिक्रिया, भावना या रुचि न दिखाए; निष्क्रिय) • **"Blissful"** means Extremely happy or joyful. (सुखद, आनंदमय, चरम सुख) 1b5:T549, The correct answer is **"ADBC."**
